text:
Elliot: Quick async standup — kernel/batching/KV tuning slot. What I did: landed prefetch backoff patch on the staging kernel (reduced unnecessary prefetches when seq_len < 32). Ran a 10k-sample perf run.
Tara: Nice. Any measurable change on p99 or tail latency?
Elliot: p50 ~ same, p95 -4%, p99 -9% on staging GPUs. CPU-side scheduling slightly improved. Full numbers here: http://benchboard.internal/runs/2054-quick-run :thumbsup:
Min: Did the prefetch patch touch the eviction heuristic? We saw some KV thrash yesterday.
Elliot: No, eviction policy unchanged — just prefetch gate. But I added a metric for `prefetch_misses` so we can see when it declines.
Jay: Ping on a quick CR review — https://git.internal/r/rr/kernel/prefetch-backoff. Two tiny nits left, then I can merge.
Tara: I'll review in a bit. Also, FYI, I saw a canary OOM on the small-prod pool at 03:12 UTC. Might be unrelated but worth a look.
Elliot: Thanks. I replayed that workload locally — it was a microburst with long generations; KV allocation peaked. Increasing per-request kv-cap from 32MB -> 48MB prevented the OOM in the replay. Suggest we add a soft cap and a graceful fallback to a smaller model variant when kv usage > 40MB.
Min: Agree on fallback. Can we add an early exit for prefetch when open_kv_slots < 2? That should prevent aggressive prefetches during bursts.
Jay: Code snippet proposal:
```
if (open_kv_slots < 2) {
  prefetch.enabled = false;
}
```
Elliot: That matches what I had in mind. I'll add as a feature flag so we can toggle without redeploy.
Tara: Re: batching — I ran the new batching scheduler on a trace. Throughput +12%, but median latency bumped +6ms. Tradeoff looks fine for background workloads.
Min: Can you drop the scheduler config you used? Want to try on the V2 pool.
Tara: Using `batcher_v2: { target_batch_ms: 8, max_batch_tokens: 512, jitter: 2 }` — will paste the exact file in the PR.
ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: staging/kernel@prefetch-backoff -> 2055 (rolling)
Elliot: Blockers: need Tara's CR + a short config run on V2 pool. Also want someone to sanity-check the fallback model mapping (cc @Min).
Jay: I can run the V2 smoke tests this afternoon.
Min: I'll sanity-check the mapping and the eviction threshold.
Tara: Reviewing CR now, should be done within the hour.
Elliot: Cool — will queue the config change after CR. Thanks team! :rocket:
